claims.statement: Andre Christol wrote from Chicago that he would wrestle Theobald Bauer only in Chicago, where he would stay for six weeks, and not in St. Louis.
claims.excerpt: I will be in Chicago for six weeks, and itis beter for me to wrentie bere than to go to St. Louis.

claims.statement: Tom Allen brought Theobald Bauer from Boston to St. Louis on the word of a Chicago friend that Andre Christol would wrestle him there.
